title: 7 Best Negotiation Courses for Sales Teams (2026)
summary: Compare online and in-person negotiation courses and certificate programs from Harvard, Yale, Kellogg, Cornell, and INSEAD by price, length, and practice.
body_markdown:
Course


Best fit


Current format and time


Practice and feedback


Listed cost


[Yale Introduction to Negotiation](https://www.coursera.org/learn/negotiation)


A flexible analytical foundation


9 modules; Coursera estimates 3 weeks at 10 hours per week


Case studies, peer negotiations, and comparison with other approaches


Coursera access terms vary


[Michigan Successful Negotiation](https://www.coursera.org/learn/negotiation-skills)


Beginners who want a short process


6 modules; Coursera estimates 2 weeks at 10 hours per week


Interactive work, a live negotiation, partner feedback, and a final exam


Coursera access terms vary


[HBS Online Negotiation Mastery](https://online.hbs.edu/courses/negotiation)


Professionals who want a structured online executive course


On-demand; 32 to 40 hours; 90 days of access


Four text-based negotiations with an AI counterpart, two attempts per exercise, and interaction-based feedback


$1,949


[Berkeley Negotiation and Influence](https://executive.berkeley.edu/programs/negotiation-and-influence-program)


Leaders who want an intensive in-person course


In person; 3 days; 22.75 total hours


Interactive simulations, in-class exercises, coaching, and feedback


$5,100


[Kellogg Negotiation Master Class](https://www.kellogg.northwestern.edu/executive-education/individual-programs/executive-programs/mneg/)


Experienced negotiators handling complex situations


Live online; 2 weeks of scheduled half-days


Simulations, role play, strengths assessment, and real-time feedback


$6,900


[Scotwork Advancing Negotiation Skills](https://www.scotwork.com/negotiation-training/)


Teams that want a high share of live case-play


Ask the provider


Scotwork says 80 percent of the course is live negotiation practice, across five live case-play exercises


Ask the provider


[Black Swan foundational courses](https://www.blackswanltd.com/foundational-courses)


Self-directed learners who want the Black Swan method


Self-paced subscription bundle


Exercises vary by course; live programs are sold separately


$59.99 per month
